# 🔥 VIRAL ANGLE OF THE WEEK (#1)
**Anti-dandruff · Sun Nov 1 – Sat Nov 7**
**13.6K views** · @megantiktokaf · Nizoral 1% Ketoconazole Shampoo
https://www.tiktok.com/@megantiktokaf/video/7702989009793993998

# 🎣 THE HOOK: "Dr. Groot or medicub? What do you recommend best?"
-# a viewer's comment, on screen in second 1, that she replies to
She opens on camera answering a real question, with before/after scalp photos up in the first second. 13.6K views and 50 comments on an 11-minute video.
**1- She answers a question people already have:**
Replying to a comment means the video starts where the viewer's head already is.
**2- Credibility before the product:**
A lab set, her diploma, a microscope, and "From a clinical lab scientist (This post is not sponsored)" on screen.
**3- The cause before the product:**
She shows a dish of fungus first, then brings out the ketoconazole shampoo. The why sells the what.
**4- Long on purpose:**
"Hold here for 2X speed looooong video…" Depth builds trust, and the comments prove it.
# 🚀 MAKE IT WORK FOR OUR KETO BUNDLE
Our buyer has tried every shampoo on the shelf and wants to know why nothing stuck.
**1- Reply to a real comment, bundle in hand:**
"Most dandruff isn't dry skin. It's fungal. And that's exactly why nothing works."
-# (ES: "La mayoría de la caspa no es piel seca. Es por hongos. Por eso nada funciona.")
**2- Explain the cause, then show the routine:**
One line on the fungus, then shampoo on the scalp, leave 2–3 min. Conditioner. Scalp spray on the itchy spots.
**3- Why it's different, in one line:**
"'Anti-dandruff' isn't the same as antifungal. That's a big difference."
-# (ES: "'Anticaspa' no es lo mismo que antifúngico. Esa es la gran diferencia.")
**4- 2–3 benefits, plain words:**
reduces visible flakes · calms my scalp · gentle enough for regular use
**5- Close with the cart:**
"Te lo dejo en el carrito naranja."
-# (I'll leave it for you in the orange cart.)
**✅ On-brief:** product visible early, bottle open and used · "calms"/"reduces flakes", never "cures"/"treats" · no "100% gone" · no prices · no other brand names
